The stock market is a complex and ever-changing landscape. As a result, it's impossible to predict with 100% accuracy how a stock will perform. However, by using technical analysis, investors can make more informed decisions about when to buy and sell stocks. Technical analysis involves studying the historical price and volume data of a stock in order to identify trends and patterns. By understanding these trends, investors can better anticipate future price movements and make more profitable trades.

A score of 10 indicates a strong indication that the stock price will go up, while a score of 0 indicates a strong indication that the stock price will go down.
